events.title: Windows Phone support ended
events.summary: Microsoft ended Windows Phone support in July 2017 — closing the third major smartphone platform for developers.
events.about: Windows Phone 8.1 and Windows 10 Mobile stopped receiving security updates and store submissions wound down. Teams that built C#/XAML apps for Lumia devices migrated to iOS and Android or abandoned mobile clients. The EOL marked Microsoft's retreat from phone hardware after acquiring Nokia's devices division.

narrative.whyChosen: Windows Phone's end shut down a native mobile platform outside the iOS–Android duopoly.
narrative.whyImportant: It consolidated mobile development into two ecosystems for most of the 2010s.
narrative.problemSolved: Microsoft exited a market it could not sustain against entrenched app stores and developer mindshare.
